main_text.p: Juftinus Goblerus J. C. abavis & majoribus fuis fæpe commemoratam fcripfit fe audi-uifle, contigiffe videl. non procul ab ipfius patria (Sanctogoarinum appellant) in civi-tate quondam imperii libera Wefalia fupe-riore, vt civiconia nidum in cujufdam ciuis tecto haberet, in quo per multos annos ova ex more excluderet, & pullos nutricaret. Tanto autem tempore eadem avis benigni hofpitis clementiam experta, vt, quæ à ne-mine domefticorum, (pio patrefamiliâs ita cavente) infeftaretur, quotannis fuo tempo-reauolare & redire, eundemq; nidum repe-tere folebat. Habuit autem in more præter cæteras fui generis aues hæc beftia, hofpitis frugi modeftia & humanitate ducta, fiue có-moditate loci ædiumq;, fiue, quod verifimi-lius eft, naturâ ad hoc ipfum irritante, vt bis, nimirum fub veris & autumni tempus pri-die feré antequam auolaret, &poftridie cum rediret, circum limen ac porticum dom° ho-fpitis fui volitaret, & ftriderti roftro fe præ-fenté velut indicaret, femp lætabundo acceu-applaudente geftu voceq; à patrefamilias ac-ceptaac rurfus dimiffa. Hæc cŭ jâ multis an-nis inter auè & hofpité confuetudo fuiffet, tâ-dé aliquando ex more fub autumnû auolatu-ra ante ad porticum dom° obftrepo imperu fert, ac crepitanti roftro, ceu hofpiti valedi-&ura infolentius aliquâto geftire vila eft, cui

page.notes: Line-end words "fe audi-uifle" and "ab avis" are read from a blurred scan: "uifle" and "abavis" are uncertain. "vt civiconia" is uncertain ("ciconia" may be correct). "fenté" and "acceu-" at the end of the line before "applaudente" are doubtful; the hyphenated join to "ceptaac" is uncertain. "Wefalia" is printed as "W efalia" with a space; the transcription keeps it joined. Lines are copied as read, with printing errors left as they are. The first word "Juftinus" carries a large initial J.
